# ImageLoader

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Loads JPEG and PNG images and extracts metadata for PDF embedding

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`MaxPixels`](#maxpixels): Largest image the loader will decode, in pixels (width x height).

### `MaxPixels`

```csharp
static long MaxPixels { get; set; }
```

*static*

Largest image the loader will decode, in pixels (width x height). An image above it is refused with an `ImageDecodeException` before any pixel data is inflated, so a small file that declares enormous dimensions cannot exhaust memory. The default of 100 million pixels is about 10,000 x 10,000; raise it for large-format print work. Process-wide, like the font registry. It applies when an image is decoded: an image already held by the process-wide image cache is not decoded again.
